title: § 7923.600 determination and segregability records for W012663 withholdings
summary:
Asks for the Department's analytical and decisional records supporting its May 14 closure of W012663-050426 (NCRIC onward-disclosures), specifically:

- Any written analysis underlying the § 7923.600 invocation for W012663 Items 2 and 6, including the threshold question of whether UOP, Stanford, or USF qualifies as a "state or local police agency" within the meaning of that exemption.
- Any segregability analysis under Gov. Code § 7922.525(b) for the same withheld records.
- A withholding log identifying record type and volume (requested in W012663's denial-procedure paragraph and not addressed in the May 14 response).
- Any records reflecting the Department's position on whether NCRIC's onward disclosure to those three universities is consistent with Civil Code § 1798.90.55(b).
- Any analysis of the W012663 Item 1 / Item 2 relationship, where Item 1 returned "no responsive records" for the underlying disclosure while Item 2 invoked § 7923.600 for audit-log entries of the same events.

policy_promises.quote: any reasonably segregable portion of a record shall be available for inspection by any person requesting the record after deletion of the portions that are exempted by law
policy_promises.tests: Does any written segregability analysis exist for the W012663 withholdings, or were they declined wholesale?

policy_promises.quote: records of complaints to, or investigations conducted by, ... any state or local police agency
policy_promises.tests: Does any written threshold analysis exist for whether UOP, Stanford, and USF are state or local police agencies?

prior_pra_refs.note: Asks for the analytical and decisional records behind W012663's May 14 dispositions, not the underlying audit-log records themselves.
The event log produced under W012570 documents SMPD-UOP networkShare activity that informs the § 7923.600 threshold question.

filed_because: W012663-050426 was closed on 2026-05-14 with Items 2 and 6 withheld under § 7923.600 and Items 1, 3, 4, 5 returned as "no responsive records." The closure did not address segregability or the threshold question of whether the receiving entities (UOP, Stanford, USF) are "state or local police agencies" under that exemption. This request asks the Department to produce the analytical and decisional records that would back the W012663 dispositions, or to confirm that no such analysis was performed.
notes:
Closed 2026-05-21 by Juliana Santiago, Management Analyst.

Item-by-item dispositions:
- Item 1 (§ 7923.600 determination records): withheld under Gov. Code § 7927.705 (attorney-client privilege) after City Attorney legal review.
- Item 2 (segregability analysis records): withheld under § 7927.705 on the same grounds.
- Item 3 (withholding log for W012663 Items 2 and 6): declined, citing Haynie v. Superior Court (2001) 26 Cal.4th 1061 for the proposition that the PRA does not require an agency to create a privilege log.
- Item 4 (records of SMPD's § 1798.90.55(b) position): "No responsive records."
- Item 5 (records describing the relationship between W012663 Item 1 and Item 2 responses): "No responsive records."

Derived status came through as needs_review because the closure phrasing was "we now consider this record request ... closed" (singular "consider"), which the CLOSED_RE in build_pra_registry.py does not match. Status set manually.
